title: DCUtR punch dial leaves ~1.25s late, so NAT remaps the port
description: Seen in the holepunch docker harness (UDX, cone NATs, fix from PR #20 applied). The remote's punch packet reached our NAT at t=30.52s, our punch dial from the listener socket only left at t=31.77s. Linux conntrack had already created an entry for remote:4001<->ourNAT:4001 from the early inbound packet, so MASQUERADE rewrote our source port (4001 -> 13988) and the remote NAT dropped everything. Same failure against go-libp2p. Suspect: Swarm applies its dial ranking/stagger delays (DelayDialRanker, happy-eyeballs) to simultaneous-connect dials; go-libp2p uses NoDelayDialRanker when GetSimultaneousConnect(ctx) is set. Also check the responder dials immediately on SYNC and the initiator waits RTT/2. Acceptance: holepunch harness cone-to-cone UDX scenario ends with a direct (non-circuit) connection, Dart<->Dart and Dart<->go.
close_reason: Fixed in fc572a9; Dart<->Dart direct UDX connection in the harness

title: Swarm Connection Reuse - Immediate Fixes
description: Critical fixes for incoming relay connection reuse: 1) Initialize _connectionLastActivity for incoming connections in _handleIncomingConnections 2) Add 60-second grace period for new connections in _isConnectionHealthy 3) Replace test stream probing with UDX PING in _probeRelayedConnection 4) Add consecutive failure tracking instead of immediate permanent failure. See doc/connectivity-improvements-brainstorm.md for details.

title: holepunch harness: peers sometimes never answer /status (2/6 --go runs)
description: run_dcutr_scenario.sh --go exited with 'peers did not come up' in 2 of 6 runs on 2026-10-03: the status() poll (40 x curl -m5 + 3s) to localhost:8081/8082 never got a response although both peers started, reserved on the relay and the Dart control API logged 'listening on 0.0.0.0:8080'. Both runs also show the relay dropping its TCP conns to the peers shortly after reservation. Find which peer is not answering and why.

title: UDX Connection Migration
description: UPDATE: Connection Migration with PATH_CHALLENGE/PATH_RESPONSE already exists in dart-udx! The work is to expose path migration events from UDX to dart-libp2p's Swarm layer so connection tracking can be updated when paths migrate. dart-udx also has CID rotation (NEW_CONNECTION_ID/RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID frames).

title: AutoRelay never picks a connected relay as candidate
description: In the holepunch harness both peers connect to the relay, AmbientAutoNATv2 reports PRIVATE, but RelayFinder logs '_maybeConnectToRelay: no candidates available' and never runs _tryNode, so no reservation is made and the host advertises a bare '/p2p-circuit' address (no relay prefix). The BasicHost peerSourceCallback yields connected peers, so either the peer source is never invoked (rate limiter/trigger) or yields nothing. Also the bare /p2p-circuit should never be advertised. The harness works around this with a /reserve control endpoint.

title: UDX Connection-Level Keepalives
description: UPDATE: PingFrame already exists in dart-udx! The work is to expose UDX's native PING through dart-libp2p's transport layer and replace the intrusive stream-based health probing in Swarm with calls to UDX PING. This is a quick win for connectivity reliability.

title: Relay v2 data limit and concurrent streams interop tests
description: Add interop tests for: large transfers over relay (v2 has data/time limits), multiple concurrent Yamux streams, and connection re-establishment after disconnect.

title: Integrate PR #28 (SilverFire) piecewise: #26 direct-conn preference, #27 yamux, lazy ACKs (#29), relayed identify (#25), observed addrs
close_reason: PR #28 integrated piecewise (59f07dc..8018b59, changelog cf5cdb4); issues #25 #26 #27 #29 closed.

title: Expose mDNS query options on MdnsDiscovery (interface, timeout, unicast, logger)
description: From closed PR #11 (syzygyinteractivemedia). MdnsDiscovery(host, {serviceName, notifee}) hard-codes its QueryParams in the private _performDiscoveryQuery (lib/p2p/discovery/mdns/mdns.dart): domain 'local', 10s timeout, no networkInterface, wantUnicastResponse false, reusePort !Platform.isAndroid (#7), reuseAddress true, multicastHops 1, no logger. Add optional constructor parameters (or an MdnsQueryOptions value) defaulting to today's values and keeping the Android reusePort rule. Additive, so a minor release. The PR author was invited to contribute it.

title: go-libp2p rejects Dart relay reservation voucher (MALFORMED_MESSAGE)
description: A go-libp2p client reserving on a Dart circuit relay v2 gets: reservation error: status: MALFORMED_MESSAGE reason: error consuming voucher envelope: failed when unmarshalling the envelope: proto: cannot parse invalid wire-format data. So go peers cannot use a Dart relay at all. Reproduce with the holepunch harness go scenario using the Dart relay-server instead of the go relay. Check the signed envelope encoding of the ReservationVoucher (payload type, domain, field numbers) against go-libp2p core/record and circuitv2 proto.

title: holepunch harness: conntrack race remaps a punch when the peer's punch arrives first
description: In 1/4 --go runs on 2026-10-03 (after dart-udx 7425a0b), both punches left from udp/4001, but the Dart responder's punch reached nat-gateway-b 0.6ms before go's punch left it; Linux conntrack recorded the inbound flow and MASQUERADE gave go's outbound punch port 21892, so the punches never met. Same mechanism as dart-libp2p-021: netem delays only gateway egress, so the relayed RTT/2 the initiator waits (~100ms) exceeds the direct one-way delay (~50ms). Real endpoint-independent NATs keep the port. Options: delay ingress too (ifb), or keep unsolicited inbound from creating conntrack entries.

title: AutoNAT v2 interop testing
description: Test AutoNAT v2 reachability probes between Go and Dart. Can be tested on localhost but less meaningful without real NAT. Go sends probes, Dart responds.

title: go-libp2p-udx-transport punch dials from a fresh socket
description: Lives in the go-libp2p-udx-transport repo, not dart-libp2p. Transport.Dial binds a new UDP socket per dial (transport.go: net.ListenUDP(udpNetwork, nil)), so a go peer's DCUtR punch leaves from a random port instead of its UDX listener port, which is the address it advertised in CONNECT. Seen in the holepunch harness --go run (go peer-b punched from 48137, its listener is 4001); the Dart side punched correctly from 4001. Same bug PR #20 fixed in the Dart UDX transport. Fix: when network.GetSimultaneousConnect(ctx) is set (or always, like go's QUIC reuse), dial from the listener's socket. Blocks Dart<->go DCUtR over UDX.
close_reason: go-libp2p-udx-transport a8d20dc: simultaneous-connect dials use the listener's socket; --go harness shows 4001<->4001 punches and go reports hole punch successful. Remaining Dart<->go race tracked in dart-libp2p-f2z.

title: Bidirectional Connection Awareness
description: Track last successful I/O per peer in both directions. Prefer connections with recent activity. Don't dial new connection if inbound path is working.

title: Failed Dart-Dart hole punch drops the relayed connection and peer's addresses
description: In the holepunch harness Dart<->Dart run (scripts/run_dcutr_scenario.sh), after the punch fails peer-a has no connection to peer-b at all (the relayed one is gone) and its peerstore has no addresses for peer-b, so /holepunch fails with 'No addresses found for peer' and a later relayed ping fails too. Addresses were added with a 1h TTL via /connect. Expected: the relayed connection survives a failed punch, as in go-libp2p, and the peerstore entry is kept. Check what closes the relayed conn (stale-connection cleanup in Swarm.dialPeer? holepunch cleanup?) and what clears or zero-TTLs the addrs (connection close -> addrBook.updateAddrs to TTL 0?).

title: Coordinated protobuf 6 / pointycastle 4 upgrade across dart_libp2p, kad_dht, pubsub
description: Remainder of upstream PR #8 (by bffzo). Bump protobuf ^6, pointycastle ^4, protoc_plugin ^25, lints ^6 in dart_libp2p together with dart_libp2p_kad_dht and dart_libp2p_pubsub (both pin protobuf ^3.1.0; kad_dht pins pointycastle ^3.7.0), regenerate all .pb.dart, raise SDK floor to ^3.7.0, and drop the deprecated lib/pb/noise re-export shims. Credit bffzo as commit author for the dart_libp2p part.
notes:
Origin: upstream PR #8 'Dependencies major upgrade' by bffzo <bffzo@proton.me> (https://github.com/stephanfeb/dart_libp2p/pull/8). The non-breaking half (Noise payload proto colocation + envelope/AutoNAT proto fixes) landed as b088993, authored by bffzo.

Why deferred: dart pub get fails if only dart_libp2p bumps protobuf, because dart_libp2p_kad_dht and dart_libp2p_pubsub (dev deps here, and their published 1.3.0) pin protobuf ^3.1.0; kad_dht also pins pointycastle ^3.7.0. protobuf 6.x and protoc_plugin 25.x require Dart SDK ^3.7.0.

Steps:
1. Bump in dart_libp2p: protobuf ^6.0.0, pointycastle ^4.0.0, protoc_plugin ^25.0.0, lints ^6.0.0, sdk ^3.7.0.
2. Same protobuf/pointycastle/protoc_plugin bumps in ../dart-libp2p-kad-dht and ../dart-libp2p-pubsub; regenerate their .pb.dart.
3. Regenerate every .pb.dart in dart_libp2p from its colocated .proto (do not hand-merge PR #8's generated files; they are stale vs circuitv2 changes).
4. Check pointycastle 4 API changes compile (kad_dht and dart_libp2p crypto).
5. Remove deprecated re-export shims lib/pb/noise/* and lib/pb/proto/noise/* (breaking: note in CHANGELOG).
6. lints ^6 will surface new analyzer infos; triage separately if noisy.
7. Release all three packages together (major bump for dart_libp2p due to SDK floor + shim removal).

Credit: commit the dart_libp2p part with --author='bffzo <bffzo@proton.me>'.
Related: dart-libp2p-t8o (DHT protobuf wire format) touches kad_dht protobuf code; coordinate ordering.

title: dart_udx joins an incoming SYN into a pending dial; go-udx keeps two connections, so Dart<->go punches race
description: UDXMultiplexer (dart-udx lib/src/multiplexer.dart) treats a SYN from an address with a pending, unhandshaken outbound socket as a simultaneous open and maps the new CID onto that socket. go-udx never joins: both sides' punches stay separate connections. When the Dart punch reaches go first (seen in 2/5 --go harness runs after go-libp2p-udx-transport a8d20dc), go's outbound dial never gets its Noise reply (stalls after msg2, or no data reaches the Dart inbound conn) and go's hole punch times out; sometimes Dart's own outbound still connects. Fix needs both UDX implementations to agree on simultaneous-open semantics (e.g. drop the join in dart_udx and let libp2p pick the connection, as with go-udx). Repro: test/integration/holepunch_network/scripts/run_dcutr_scenario.sh --go with GOLOG_LOG_LEVEL=error,swarm2=debug,upgrader=debug,p2p-holepunch=debug.
close_reason: dart-udx 7425a0b: crossing dials stay two connections, dials never reuse an accepted connection; dart-libp2p UDXListener keeps sessions per connection. --go harness: 3/4 PASS with go reporting hole punch success; the 4th failed on the harness conntrack race (dart-libp2p-725).

title: Connectivity Improvements - Connection Reuse & Reliability
description: Investigate and fix connection reuse issues: 1) Incoming relay connections not reused for outbound, 2) Aggressive health checking marking working connections as failed, 3) Activity tracking gap for new connections. See doc/connectivity-improvements-brainstorm.md

title: Signed peer record envelope round-trip verification
description: Verify signed peer record envelopes round-trip correctly between Dart and Go during identify exchange. Check envelope signature validation and address certification.

title: Relay Connection Race Condition - Connection Not Found During Upgrade
description: When incoming relay connection arrives, upgradeInbound takes time (Noise+Yamux negotiation). During upgrade, if app tries to dial back, connectedness() returns notConnected because SwarmConn not yet created. System then tries direct dial which times out. Fix: 1) Mark peer as connected (with placeholder) during upgrade 2) Prefer relay addresses for peers that connected via relay

title: AutoNATv2 client never matches a dial-back nonce
description: client.dart looked up _dialBackQueues (Map<int, ...>) with the protobuf Int64 nonce from the DialBack message. Int64 and int never match as map keys, so every dial-back was rejected as 'invalid nonce' and every probe failed with 'Invalid response: dialBackAddr: null'; ambient AutoNAT always reported unknown. Found while testing the dart-libp2p-dth fix.

title: ECDSA public keys marshal as SEQUENCE{x,y} instead of PKIX
description: EcdsaPublicKey.raw (lib/core/crypto/ecdsa.dart) encodes a bare ASN.1 SEQUENCE of the point's x and y, and fromRawBytes parses that form. The libp2p spec and go-libp2p use DER PKIX (x509.MarshalPKIXPublicKey), so Go ECDSA keys fail to unmarshal (now reachable through Noise since Darren Warner's commit from PR #10) and our ECDSA peer IDs do not match Go's. Fix like RSA in fd02f2b: marshal PKIX, accept both on unmarshal, add go-libp2p vectors (see test/crypto/rsa_go_interop_test.dart). ECDSA private keys: Go uses x509.MarshalECPrivateKey (SEC1).

title: STUN Integration for NAT Type Detection
description: Integrate STUN to detect NAT type (full cone, restricted, symmetric). Skip futile direct dial attempts for symmetric NAT. Guide address ranking.

title: Circuit Relay Address Format Fix - Missing Relay Peer ID
description: CRITICAL: Incoming relay connections were storing addresses without the relay's peer ID (e.g., /ip4/.../udx/p2p-circuit/p2p/DEST instead of /ip4/.../udx/p2p/RELAY_ID/p2p-circuit/p2p/DEST). This caused canDial() to reject the addresses when trying to dial back to peers that connected via relay, resulting in 'No transport found for address' errors. Fixed by including relay peer ID in circuit address construction in _handleStreamV2.

title: Fresh clone cannot resolve dependencies: kad-dht/pubsub dev deps require dart_libp2p <3.0.0
description: dart_libp2p is 4.0.0, but its dev_dependencies dart_libp2p_kad_dht ^1.3.0 and dart_libp2p_pubsub ^1.3.0 (both 1.3.0 on pub.dev) require dart_libp2p >=1.0.0 <3.0.0, so pub get fails without the committed dependency_overrides that point at sibling checkouts (../dart-udx, ../dart-libp2p-kad-dht, ../dart-libp2p-pubsub). Only test/interop/go_dht_interop_test.dart, test/interop/go_pubsub_interop_test.dart, test/interop/go_interop_udx_stability_test.dart and bin/dht_relay_netem_test.dart import them. Options: release kad-dht and pubsub accepting dart_libp2p <5.0.0, then move the path overrides to a git-ignored pubspec_overrides.yaml; or move those tests into the sibling packages and drop the dev deps. Raised by PR #11.
close_reason: Option 2: DHT/pubsub interop tests moved to dart_libp2p_kad_dht and dart_libp2p_pubsub, dev deps and committed overrides removed, dart_udx override in git-ignored pubspec_overrides.yaml. Fresh-clone simulation resolves from pub.dev with no new analyzer errors.

title: DHT: Switch wire format from JSON to protobuf for Go interop
description:
dart-libp2p-kad-dht has two wire format issues blocking Go interop:

1. **JSON encoding instead of protobuf**: The IpfsDHT uses jsonEncode/jsonDecode for DHT messages (dht.dart lines ~350, ~370, ~1550, ~1585), but the spec requires protobuf. The protobuf types already exist in lib/src/pb/dht.pb.dart.

2. **Missing varint-length framing**: Go DHT uses go-msgio (varint length prefix + protobuf bytes). The Dart DHT does raw stream.read()/stream.write() without length-prefix framing.

Both must be fixed: switch to Message.writeToBuffer()/mergeFromBuffer() and add varint-length framing around each message.

Blocking: DHT interop tests in dart-libp2p (test/interop/go_dht_interop_test.dart) are skipped.

title: Hole Punching (DCUtR) interop testing
description: Test DCUtR (/libp2p/dcutr) protocol between Dart and Go. Requires simulated NAT or multi-machine setup. Relay interop is done (prerequisite). Needs: NAT simulation, coordination protocol impl verification.
close_reason: Dart<->go DCUtR verified in the docker NAT harness (scripts/run_dcutr_scenario.sh --go): coordination over a go relay, punches 4001<->4001, direct UDX connection, go reports hole punch success. Remaining harness flakes: dart-libp2p-725, dart-libp2p-1pg.

title: Holepunch docker harness could never simulate NAT
description: Fixes for test/integration/holepunch_network: NAT gateways had EXTERNAL/INTERNAL interfaces swapped (Docker puts the private net on eth0), so MASQUERADE never applied; public net was 10.10/16, which isPublic() treats as private, so DCUtR had no public addresses; cone NAT used MASQUERADE --random (symmetric behaviour); TCP only, so UDX socket reuse was untestable; no way to get a relay reservation (see AutoRelay bug); Dockerfile did not copy the kad-dht/pubsub path overrides; success check only counted connected peers (relay counts). Add UDX + EXTERNAL_ADDRS, /reserve, a scenario driver that checks for a non-circuit connection, and a go-libp2p peer/relay variant for interop.
